title: Song Pal
style: Country-western club mix with driving four-on-the-floor stomp, twangy Telecaster licks, handclap snaps, and a big chant-ready groove; verse rides sparse guitar, bass, and kick, pre-chorus lifts with stacked gang shouts, chorus hits with hoedown fiddle lines and call-and-response hooks. Vocal treatment uses close-mic lead, doubled hook lines, and crowd-style ad-libs. Ear candy includes whip pans, yodel breaks, and a pickup-riser into each drop. Bright, punchy, wide mix with club-sized low end., world, country
